errorCodes.INVALID_FRAME: Frame or image dimensions are invalid.
errorCodes.DECODE_FAILED: The input could not be decoded.
errorCodes.TARGET_TOO_SMALL: The static scene region is too small or outside the frame.
errorCodes.LOW_TEXTURE: The selected static scene has insufficient texture.
errorCodes.LOW_CONTRAST: The selected static scene has insufficient contrast.
errorCodes.SCENE_CHANGED: The scene cannot be represented by one motion model.
errorCodes.CAMERA_ROTATION_TOO_LARGE: Camera rotation exceeds the supported local approximation.
errorCodes.FLOW_LOST: Too few features survived optical-flow checks.
errorCodes.BACKGROUND_UNTRACKABLE: The static scene cannot be used as a tracking anchor.
errorCodes.FPS_UNSTABLE: Frame timestamps are too irregular for speed estimation.
errorCodes.RUNTIME_MISSING: The local computer-vision runtime is unavailable.
